Scottsdale Quarter Date Night: The Art of Romantic Transportation

Scottsdale Quarter has established itself as North Scottsdale's premier destination for upscale dining, boutique shopping, and sophisticated entertainment. When you're planning a special date night — anniversary, proposal, or simply a memorable evening — the transportation you choose sets the tone before you even arrive.

The short answer: a chauffeured Luxury SUV is $125/hr with a 4-hour minimum, so a 4-hour dinner date is $500 before tax. For the night that has to be perfect, the Maybach Jet Sprinter is $295/hr with a 4-hour minimum — the most refined cabin in our fleet, and every vehicle we run is brand new.

Why Scottsdale Quarter for Date Night?

The Setting

Scottsdale Quarter combines the best elements of an upscale outdoor shopping center with a restaurant row that rivals anywhere in the Valley. The architecture, landscaping, and atmosphere create a naturally romantic environment.

Creating the Perfect Date Night

The Transportation Advantage

Arrival Impact:
Pulling up in a chauffeured vehicle versus circling for parking — completely different energy. When your date steps out of a brand-new black SUV at the curb, the evening has already begun.

No Driving Means:

  • Order the wine without calculating
  • No "who's driving home" discussion
  • Both partners fully present
  • Romantic ride home together

For Proposals:
If you're planning to pop the question, the privacy of a chauffeured vehicle on the way home is infinitely better than being behind the wheel trying to drive and react.

Scottsdale Quarter Logistics

Getting There

  • From Central Scottsdale: north on Scottsdale Road
  • From Phoenix: Loop 101 north
  • From Tempe: Loop 101 north

Where We Drop Off

For general drop-off:

  • Main entrance at Scottsdale Road
  • Near your specific restaurant
  • Discretion as needed

Parking Alternative

Scottsdale Quarter has free parking, but:

  • Garages are confusing to navigate
  • Long walks from remote spots
  • Finding the car after dinner = mood killer
  • No romance in a parking lot

Booking Your Romantic Evening

When to Book

Availability varies by date and by vehicle. Request a current quote for your date and we will confirm what is open. Paid online checkout closes 24 hours before pickup; inside that window, call our reservations team.

What We Need to Know

  • Number of passengers
  • Pickup address
  • Restaurant reservation time
  • Special occasion? (Tell us!)
  • Champagne/roses preferences
  • Any surprises we should know about

Making It Personal

We want every date night to feel special:

  • Favorite music playing on arrival
  • Temperature preferences
  • Beverage preferences
  • Any requests that make it yours

Policies

Cancellation terms depend on your date and booking; read the cancellation policy before you book. One free date change at 72+ hours. See our policies page.
